## Astraeus 2.8.7

### New
- **Automatic updates, as a switch.** A small **Automatic updates** switch now sits under **Check for updates** in Settings. Turn it off and Astraeus only looks for a new version when you press the button or pick **Check for updates** in the tray menu. It's on by default, and `AutoUpdate = false` in `astraeus.ini` still works.
- **Notifications can stay on HaloBar.** If you use HaloBar 0.0.14 or newer and turn on **Keep them on HaloBar** in its settings, notification pills rise from HaloBar only and Astraeus shows none. Astraeus' notification card says **Shown by HaloBar** while that's on.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
